items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: So eventually he got Sonny and Joe Williams came in at the same time you know. So that’s when, the band really started to get together you know. Before that I mean when I joined the band...

ctx.x: Well that’s, bands, they’ve done that. All bands, most bands when they first start out, you know they start out like that because they don’t have any music, so you’ve got to start like that, you know. When I was with Billy Eckstine’s band, it started out the same way, you know. You start out, you’ve got two or three arrangements and you’ve got to do a job four or five hours, and you’ve got to have a book so you make up music as you go. That arrangement on “Every Day” that Joe Williams did, the band was playing it…
That’s great. That’s like arranging in reverse almost.
